item.title: Tuna Avocado Salad
item.description: This quick and easy tuna and avocado salad is a little bit different as it leaves out the mayonnaise and uses fresh flavors to bring a new twist on a favorite lunch or a snack.

item.title: Sweet and Spicy Sweet Potato Soup
item.description: This earthy fall sweet potato soup is balanced by fresh tart apples, spicy ginger, and bright lime zest and juice in this easy, any season recipe!

item.title: Spicy Tomato Soup
item.description: Warm up your menu with this spicy Indian-inspired curried tomato soup.

item.title: Spicy Black Bean Salad
item.description: This spicy black bean salad recipe combines black beans, corn, salsa, cilantro, and lime juice to make a refreshing salad-perfect with tortilla chips.

item.title: Southern Coleslaw with Mayo
item.description: Best coleslaw ever! Great for grilling just about anything!

item.title: Smoked Salmon French Toast Sandwich
item.description: Smoked salmon and cream cheese top decadent, egg soaked French bread to make this recipe for smoked salmon French toast sandwich.

item.title: Skinny Crustless Spinach Quiche
item.description: For a skinny lunch that doesn't skimp on flavor, try this crustless spinach quiche with mushrooms and fat-free cheese.

item.title: Salad with Prosciutto and Caramelized Pears and Walnuts
item.description: This delectable salad is comprised of romaine hearts tossed with golden, caramelized pears and walnuts, strips of succulent prosciutto and a full-bodied orange vinaigrette.

item.title: Roasted Sweet Potato Mango Salad
item.description: This refreshing roasted sweet potato salad is accented with mangoes, avocado, cilantro, and habanero pepper for a spicy kick!

item.title: Ricotta Toast with Bacon and Tomato
item.description: This creamy, flavorful toast with ricotta, cherry tomatoes, and bacon uses thick-cut crusty bread, and can be eaten for breakfast, or at any time of day.

item.title: Quinoa Oatmeal Cookies
item.description: These gluten-free quinoa oatmeal cookies with dark chocolate and pecans are reminiscent of chewy granola bars, great for a snack on the go.

item.title: Quiche au Chou Romanesco (Romanesco and Mushroom Quiche)
item.description: Nutty Romanesco cauliflower florets sauteed with mushrooms and oregano make a delicious filling for this quiche in a puff pastry shell.

item.title: Potato Salad III
item.description: A versatile potato salad with lots of flavor and a nice crunch

item.title: Pea Salad II
item.description: This salad has a definite sweetness about it. A bit of sugar is added to the dressing and sweet pickles are tossed in with the peas, onions, celery, eggs and cheese. Makes six generous servings.

item.title: Pasta Salad in a Jar
item.description: This quick and easy pasta salad is a great on-the-go lunch that layers tortellini, pesto, tomatoes, and mache lettuce in a canning jar.

item.title: Pasta e Fagioli ala Weeble
item.description: Pasta, beans, and a thick broth - a perfect description for Pasta e Fagiole. Weeble's version evokes memories of Toronto's Little Italy.

item.title: Pacific Cuban Black Beans and Rice
item.description: Cuban-style black beans simmered with chorizo sausages and spices served over rice is a remarkably hearty family meal.

item.title: Oven Barbecued Chicken and Potatoes
item.description: This one-dish meal of chicken and potatoes baked in homemade barbecue sauce has a savory, sweet, and slightly spicy flavor.

item.title: Nina's Cucumber Salad
item.description: Cucumbers are tossed together with reduced-fat sour cream, lemon juice, red onion, and dill for a light and refreshing summer salad.

item.title: Minty Green Bean Salad
item.description: Green beans with a hint of mint are blended with a tangy vinaigrette.

item.title: Mediterranean Pasta Salad with Hummus
item.description: This Mediterranean-inspired pasta salad is dressed with hummus and flecked with red onion, feta cheese, and fresh basil.

item.title: Julie's Crunchy Potato Salad
item.description: Celery, carrots, and bell peppers add plenty of crunch and color to this tasty potato salad.

item.title: Hearty Vegetarian Minestrone
item.description: Loaded with tomatoes, beans, and macaroni, this vegetarian minestrone is a simple and hearty soup that will warm you up on a cold day.

item.title: Grilled Pineapple and Prosciutto Flatbread
item.description: Chef John proves the pairing of pineapple and ham is a success with these savory and sweet grilled pineapple and prosciutto flatbreads.

item.title: Grilled Corn Salad with Peppers
item.description: This colorful corn salad mixes grilled corn with peppers, spices, and lime juice--it's a great side for picnics and potlucks but works as a condiment for sandwiches and tacos, too!

item.title: Greek Smashed Pita
item.description: This Greek smashed pita is like a cross between a beloved smashburger and a delicious gyros. Greek-seasoned ground sirloin, topped with salad and tzatziki, are folded inside a lightly toasted pita for a savory handheld lunch.

item.title: Goddess Beet Salad
item.description: This creation is a simple beet salad with the wonderful flavors of garlic, onion, and Feta cheese.

item.title: Elote Ramen Noodles
item.description: These elote ramen noodles are fusion at its finest! Grilled corn and jalapeno ramen, with a hot mayo, cotija, and cilantro, are a kicked-up ramen combo you will love.

item.title: Delicious Spinach Salad
item.description: A colorful mix of carrots, feta cheese, black beans, and pine nuts makes this lightly dressed spinach salad a nice accompaniment to any meal.

item.title: Dallas-Style Sloppy Joes
item.description: A zesty sauce, fresh onion, and bell pepper make this easy-to-make sandwich a Dallas-area favorite.

item.title: Chicken Salad with Bacon and Dates
item.description: Bacon and dates add a sweet and savory component to this delightful chicken salad recipe.

item.title: California Roll Cucumber Salad
item.description: This California roll cucumber salad is easy: mix sliced cucumber, diced crab, diced avocado, seaweed, rice vinegar, soy sauce, pickled ginger, and sesame seeds in a glass jar to make this TikTok viral salad.

item.title: Baked Tomato Mac n Cheese Casserole
item.description: Sharp white Cheddar cheese is melted into a roux and macaroni cooked with diced tomatoes to give a new spin to macaroni and cheese in this recipe.

item.title: Algerian Flafla (Bell Pepper Salad)
item.description: Roasted green bell peppers are cooked until meltingly tender with olive oil, garlic, onion, and chopped tomatoes. Scoop up the salad with slices of baguette.

item.title: Hummus Pancake with Mediterranean Spice Mix
item.description: Hummus pancakes, made with chickpeas, tahini, and spices, are a Mediterranean-inspired brunch or lunch item. Serve with a sprinkling of spice and salt.

item.title: Most Requested Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
item.description: Banana chocolate chip muffins will become the most requested treat by everyone in your family after whipping up this recipe.

item.title: Egg Salad with Celery
item.description: This egg salad with celery recipe uses on six simple ingredients-hard-cooked eggs, chopped onion, chopped celery, mayonnaise, mustard powder, and salt.

item.title: Chicken Gyros
item.description: Roasted vegetables and marinated chicken join homemade tzatziki in these light and fresh chicken gyro sandwiches.

item.title: Summer Pasta Salad I
item.description: Penne pasta and fresh vegetables are tossed with Catalina and Italian-style dressings.

item.title: Most Amazing Salad! Tomato, Mozzarella, Avocado, and Bliss
item.description: Caprese salad with an easy dressing gets an extra nutty richness from cubes of avocado.

item.title: Quick Red Curry Soup
item.description: This is a quick recipe for a Thai-inspired coconut-curry soup with shrimp and chicken.

item.title: Pat's Baked Potato Salad
item.description: This hot potato salad is a wonderful addition to any meal. Make it in advance, and heat it up just before serving.

item.title: Roasted Eggplant Parmesan Focaccia
item.description: Perfect for lunch on a cold day, these warm, open-faced, eggplant Parmesan sandwiches are made on focaccia bread with tender roasted eggplant and a tasty tomato sauce.

item.title: Avocado, Tuna, and Tomato Salad
item.description: This isn't your average tuna salad--it combines the ease of canned tuna with avocado, tomato, and feta cheese for a quick and tasty lunch.

item.title: Cheesy Quiche Crust
item.description: This flaky quiche crust recipe with Cheddar cheese makes a tasty base for any savory filling and will make any quiche taste exceptionally good.

item.title: Honey Mustard Macaroni Salad
item.description: This macaroni salad with mustard is a family recipe with hard-boiled eggs, onion, celery, pickle relish, and bell pepper for a tasty picnic dish.

item.title: Honey Mustard Tuna Salad
item.description: Try this honey mustard tuna salad with honey mustard flavor, sweet pickle relish, and less mayo. Serve on bread with lettuce and tomato for a quick lunch.

item.title: Cottage Cheese Tomato Soup
item.description: This cottage cheese tomato soup is creamy and with a high-protein twist-cottage cheese, bone broth, and nutritional yeast add flavor and nutrients to classic tomato soup

item.title: Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese Casserole
item.description: This tomato soup and grilled cheese casserole tastes like the classic combo: Campbell's tomato soup with grilled cheese sandwiches. The baked-in grilled cheese cubes are golden, melty, and delicious.

item.title: Smoked Corned Beef Sandwiches with Coleslaw
item.description: An easy homemade coleslaw adds fresh taste and crunch to tender and flavorful smoked corned beef sandwiches.

item.title: Pea and Avocado Salad
item.description: Avocado is tossed with peas, tiny shrimp, olives, onions, and seasonings, then served in the shells made by the scooped-out avocado peels.

item.title: White Bean Tabbouleh
item.description: A bulgur wheat and parsley salad (tabbouleh) gets extra color and flavor from tomato, yellow bell pepper and white beans.

item.title: Tropical Quinoa Salsa Salad
item.description: Quinoa combines with tropical fruit salsa ingredients in a spunky salad with a lime-pineapple vinaigrette.

item.title: Gourmet Patty Melts
item.description: Lean ground sirloin burgers, sauteed onions, and Cheddar cheese come together for a heavenly patty melt experience.

item.title: Orange Vegetables Soup
item.description: This soup is made from orange-colored vegetables: pumpkin, butternut squash, carrots, and sweet potatoes.

item.title: Fall Quinoa Salad with Poppy Seed Dressing
item.description: The flavors of fall combine in this easy sweet potato salad made with cranberries, leftover quinoa, beets, Brussels sprouts, and a homemade poppy seed dressing.

item.title: Easy Peezy Sweet Toasted Cheese Sandwich
item.description: It doesn't get much easier than Hawaiian-style sweet bread rolls topped with Cheddar cheese slices for melting.

item.title: Heirloom Carrot and Radish Salad
item.description: Served with a delicious lime and honey dressing, this fresh crunchy heirloom carrot and radish salad is excellent paired with any meal.

item.title: Cold Cucumber Soup
item.description: This cold cucumber soup is quick to make and really refreshing. Cucumbers combine with yogurt, buttermilk, garlic, mint, and parsley for a lovely summer starter.

item.title: Easy German Potato Salad
item.description: Cucumbers are the unique ingredient in this variation on German-style potato salad that is simple to prepare.

item.title: Quick and Easy Curry Chicken Salad for Lunches
item.description: This flavorful curry chicken salad is an easy recipe to make ahead for a week of effortless but delicious lunches.
